guards.name: epoch
guards.rule: Bound port PageSession/Runtime/lane identity matches; section 2.

guards.name: scope
guards.rule: Registered live scope or admitted system/root operation; section 5.

guards.name: authority
guards.rule: Captured namespace/AuthEpoch/grant matches operation owner; section 22.

guards.name: quota
guards.rule: Reserve bytes/work/request-terminal slot before accepting ownership; sections 4/26.

guards.name: schema
guards.rule: Closed field types, lengths, enum members and payload schemas validate.

guards.name: bootstrap
guards.rule: Only bootstrap state and bound host may use null scope/authority.

guards.name: request-match
guards.rule: Request/correlation, opcode, direction, scope and tombstone match.

guards.name: result-schema
guards.rule: Success payload type is selected by registered original request opcode.

guards.name: credit-monotone
guards.rule: Cumulative released counts never exceed admitted sends or move backwards.

guards.name: reserved-control
guards.rule: Fixed bounded control/terminal capacity reserved at request acceptance.

guards.name: clock
guards.rule: Timestamp is converted to the negotiated root time domain.

guards.name: authority-controller
guards.rule: Only the bound host authorization controller can change authority.

guards.name: ui-stamp
guards.rule: TreeEpoch/root/revision and region base match; retired input follows event fence.

guards.name: node-kind
guards.rule: Property/operation valid for this node kind and managed placement.

guards.name: field-target
guards.rule: FieldKey immutable; target/schema/permissions validated before adoption.

guards.name: edit-lease
guards.rule: Native lease is owned and its relocation/adoption policy permits transition.

guards.name: binding-current
guards.rule: Correct node/binding generation or explicitly retained old action.

guards.name: edit-sequence
guards.rule: Exact expected session and state sequence; composition policy applies.

guards.name: device
guards.rule: DeviceEpoch valid and profile permits the descriptor.

guards.name: resource-kind
guards.rule: Handle kind, owner, version state and source-specific grant match.

guards.name: surface
guards.rule: SurfaceEpoch/layout/size and surface ownership match.

guards.name: sealed-versions
guards.rule: Every input is immutable and host retains the exact version before admission.

guards.name: graph
guards.rule: Acyclic producer/consumer, load/store, attachment/format and private-transient validation.

guards.name: scene-lease
guards.rule: Retained bundle/mapping/dependencies match the pick/geometry request.

guards.name: input-view
guards.rule: ViewToken identifies the retained input-time interaction basis.

guards.name: private-outputs
guards.rule: GPU writes are restricted to unpublished job/frame-owned outputs.

guards.name: shader-admission
guards.rule: Reviewed shader/layout hash and bounded profile, not arbitrary shader text.

guards.name: capability
guards.rule: Configured capability/route/resource-kind policy permits the call.
